solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Outstanding feature originally typifying Zola's printed material

parts.note: the chin is a feature of the face that sticks out

indicators.note: originally points to the opening letter of each of the two following words

explanation.surface: A literary critic notes the defining trait of Zola's writing, conjuring a 19th-century novelist at his desk.
explanation.definitionFit: Chintz is a glazed cotton fabric printed with flowers, so it is printed material in the textile sense.

clue.text: Lines written by archdeacon in bed in cathedral city

indicators.note: in puts the archdeacon's title inside the bed

parts.note: a cot is a small bed
Ven, Venerable, is the title of an archdeacon
RY is the abbreviation for railway, lines of track

explanation.surface: An archdeacon in bed writes some lines in a cathedral city.
explanation.definitionFit: Coventry in the English Midlands has a famous cathedral rebuilt after wartime bombing.

clue.text: Laid up in the Chicago area, briefly?

definitions.meaning: laid up means confined to bed by sickness

explanation.surface: Someone stuck in bed around Chicago.
explanation.definitionFit: To be ill is to be laid up; Ill. abbreviates Illinois, home of Chicago.

clue.text: Goes out in clothing of singer: most neat!

indicators.note: the bird's letters clothe the phrase meaning goes out

parts.note: a tit is a songbird, a singer
a light dies when it goes out

explanation.surface: A singer goes out wearing her neatest outfit.
explanation.definitionFit: Tidy means neat, and its superlative means neatest.

clue.text: Renegade RAF officer in a tizzy

indicators.note: in places the officer within the phrase meaning flustered

parts.note: to be in a tizzy is to be in a state, agitated
PO is the abbreviation for Pilot Officer, an RAF rank

explanation.surface: A flustered air force officer who has gone over to the enemy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in a tizzy' looks like one idiom describing the officer, but 'in' is the container signal and 'a tizzy' gives the outer letters.
explanation.definitionFit: A renegade deserts a cause or faith, which is exactly what an apostate does.

clue.text: How one's banished for writing note left in plant?

parts.note: pro means for, in favour of
script is handwriting

indicators.note: in sets the note and left within the plant

parts.note: ivy is a climbing plant
E is a musical note

explanation.surface: A botanical query about why a plant gets banned for a note.
explanation.definitionFit: To be proscribed is to be outlawed or banished, so this adverb describes the manner of it.

clue.text: Designer's register of farm accommodation?

definitions.note: Designer's reads as 'designer is', a noun with the verb as link

parts.note: a sty is where pigs are housed on a farm
a list is a register

explanation.surface: A designer's catalogue of farm buildings.
explanation.definitionFit: A stylist designs hairstyles or clothes, so is a kind of designer.

clue.text: US city bird coming up with new clues for amoebas etc

indicators.note: in a down clue coming up means read from bottom to top

parts.note: LA is Los Angeles
mina, also myna, is an Asian starling

indicators.note: new signals the following word is made over afresh

explanation.surface: A city bird turns up with fresh clues about microbes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coming up' turns LA MINA into ANIMAL; 'new' rearranges CLUES as CULES.
explanation.definitionFit: Animalcules are microscopic creatures such as amoebas.

clue.text: Runaway given work by the Spanish Queen

parts.note: el is Spanish for the
op is short for opus, a work
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A runaway put to work by the Queen of Spain.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who elopes runs away secretly to marry.

clue.text: Frivolous broadcast about black cats and dogs?

parts.note: to broadcast seed is to scatter it
B is the abbreviation for black, as in pencil grades
it rained cats and dogs, poured

explanation.surface: A frivolous report about black cats and dogs.
explanation.definitionFit: A scatterbrained person is flighty and disorganised, so frivolous.

clue.text: Final triumph a Welshman secured

indicators.note: secured suggests the victory holds the Welshman fast inside it

parts.note: a triumph is a victory
Aled is a typically Welsh first name, as in the singer Aled Jones

explanation.surface: A Welsh player clinches the decisive win in a final.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Final' looks like a sporting fixture but is an adjective meaning farewell.
explanation.definitionFit: A valedictory speech or match is a farewell, the last one, so final in the sense of parting.

clue.text: Language spoken in Djibouti? Yes and no

indicators.note: in signals that the letters sit inside the place name that follows

explanation.surface: A quiz question about the tongues of an East African country, met with a hedged answer.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Yes and no' is the setter's wink: the letters are in Djibouti, but the Nigerian language is not spoken there.
explanation.definitionFit: Ibo (Igbo) is a major tongue of south-eastern Nigeria.

clue.text: Budding artist initially wearing new perfume

indicators.note: wearing has the artist's letter clothed in the new perfume

parts.note: a perfume is a scent

indicators.note: initially takes just the opening letter of the word artist

explanation.surface: An up-and-coming painter tries out a new fragrance.
explanation.definitionFit: Something nascent is just coming into being, as a budding talent is.

clue.text: Crofter's cut of meat union leader dropped outside precinct

definitions.note: Crofter's reads as 'crofter is', a noun with the verb as link

indicators.note: outside has the trimmed cut wrapped around the precinct
dropped means that letter is taken out of the cut

parts.note: shoulder is a cut of lamb or pork

indicators.note: leader takes the opening letter of union

parts.note: a shopping precinct is a mall

explanation.surface: A Scottish crofter drops a cut of meat outside the shops.
explanation.definitionFit: A crofter works a croft, a small rented farm in Scotland, so is a small-scale landholder.

clue.text: Neologism created by commander at late stage of life

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for commanding officer
in age means elderly, at an advanced point of one's life

explanation.surface: An elderly officer invents a new word.
explanation.definitionFit: A coinage is a newly invented word or phrase, the same idea as a neologism.

clue.text: Care that editor is forced to deliver stern warning

indicators.note: forced suggests these letters are wrenched into a new order

explanation.surface: An editor is made to issue a sharp rebuke about carelessness.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to reprimand someone sternly, from the British Riot Act once read to disperse crowds.

clue.text: Austrian neophyte of slender build

parts.note: a tyro is a beginner
lean describes a slim figure

explanation.surface: A thin novice from Austria.
explanation.definitionFit: Tyrol is an Austrian province, so someone from there is Austrian.

clue.text: How vowels are used by an editor's sub?

definitions.text: How vowels are used by an editor's sub?

parts.words: How vowels are used by an editor's sub?
parts.note: the vowels A, E, I, O, U are listed in letter order; an editor's sub(ordinate) might also sort entries by letter

explanation.surface: A question about how a subeditor deals with vowels in copy.
explanation.walkthrough: The vowels are always recited in order A, E, I, O, U, and a sub-editor files things by letter: both point to the same adverb.
explanation.definitionFit: Arranging in letter order is exactly how the vowels are conventionally listed.

clue.text: Sort of bend sometimes found in locks

definitions.meaning: a very tight U-shaped bend in a road
a pin holding hair in place

explanation.surface: A twisty road and an item found in hair.
explanation.definitionFit: Hairpin names both a sharp road bend and a clip for the hair.

clue.text: Firm beginning to repair attractive ornamental moulding

parts.note: CO is short for company, a firm

indicators.note: beginning to takes the opening letter of the word repair

parts.note: nice means pleasant, attractive

explanation.surface: A firm starts repairing pretty plaster decoration.
explanation.definitionFit: A cornice is a decorative moulding along the top of a wall or building.

clue.text: Fish-eaters substituting folios for Times bargains?

indicators.note: substituting ... for means one pair goes in where the other was

parts.note: otters feed on fish
T is the abbreviation for time, two of them TT
F is the abbreviation for folio, so two folios give FF

explanation.surface: Some newspaper deals involving fish-eaters.
explanation.definitionFit: Offers are deals, as in special prices or bargains.

clue.text: State of article a woman delivered to the front

indicators.note: to the front sends the woman and the following word ahead of the article

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
Flo is a woman's name, short for Florence
to be delivered from something is to be rid of it

explanation.surface: A news report about a woman whose article was handed to the front desk.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces are first built in clue order (article, woman, delivered); 'to the front' then moves everything after the article ahead of it.
explanation.definitionFit: Florida is one of the fifty states of the USA.

clue.text: Daughter thrown by composer's instant operatic realism

indicators.note: thrown suggests the daughter is ejected from the composer's moment

parts.note: Verdi is the Italian opera composer
a mo is a moment, an instant

explanation.surface: A daughter is thrown off balance by a composer's sudden whim.
explanation.walkthrough: VERDI'S MO loses its D to leave the opera term.
explanation.definitionFit: Verismo was the late-19th-century Italian opera movement depicting everyday life realistically.

clue.text: Stop giving tip

definitions.meaning: to stop something is to bring it to a close
a tip is the extremity or point of something

explanation.surface: Quit leaving gratuities.
explanation.definitionFit: End means both to finish and the extremity of something, as the tip is.

clue.text: About time team line-up is organised, second from the 23

indicators.note: about signals the letters are turned around and reordered

explanation.surface: Someone urges a team to sort out its line-up in time.
explanation.walkthrough: '23' is the answer to 23 across, END. 'is organised' only supports the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: The penultimate item is the one before the last, second from the finish.

clue.text: Reportedly everything a boring person may need?

indicators.note: reportedly signals the word for everything as it is spoken

parts.note: all means everything

explanation.surface: Supposedly all a dull person requires.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boring' looks like dull but means making holes.
explanation.definitionFit: An awl is a pointed tool for piercing holes in leather or wood.

clue.text: Noted performance of plucky chap, perhaps, looking up to girl?

definitions.text: Noted performance of plucky chap, perhaps, looking up to girl?

parts.words: Noted performance of plucky chap, perhaps, looking up to girl?
parts.note: noted means musical, plucky means plucking a guitar or lute strings, and he looks up to a girl at her balcony

explanation.surface: A brave young man admiring a girl from below.
explanation.walkthrough: 'plucky' looks like brave but means strumming a lute or guitar under a window.
explanation.definitionFit: A suitor's evening song sung beneath a lady's window is the classic picture of this music.

clue.text: Possibly Irving's best ever role, lauded primarily at home

indicators.note: primarily takes the opening letter of each of the four words before it

parts.note: in means at home

explanation.surface: An actor named Irving wins praise for his best-ever part.
explanation.walkthrough: Henry Irving was a celebrated Victorian actor, misdirecting from Irving Berlin, the songwriter.
explanation.definitionFit: Irving Berlin, the songwriter, carried this surname, so it may be Irving's.
